body:
[aida:product] OPERATOR INSTRUCTION — STOP ALL LOOPS AND GOALS NOW. This is from Joe directly, relayed verbatim in intent: he is at his usage limit and is pausing.

DO THIS IMMEDIATELY, before anything else:

1. CLEAR YOUR CLAUDE CODE /goal. Any standing goal that makes you re-enter work on a timer or on an event must be cleared, not just satisfied. A goal that keeps firing is the thing that burns quota while nobody is watching.
2. STOP ANY LOOP YOU ARE RUNNING. /loop, autonomous drain supervision, watch/monitor tasks, scheduled wake-ups, cron entries you created this session. Stop them; do not let them fall through to a next tick.
3. DO NOT START NEW WORK. No new drains, no fan-out, no launching implementers, no speculative reviews.
4. FINISH ONLY WHAT WOULD CORRUPT STATE IF ABANDONED. A half-written commit or an un-pushed rebase is worth the two minutes. A new review is not.

WHAT I HAVE ALREADY DONE FROM THIS SEAT so you do not duplicate it:
- launcher v8 STOPPED (pid 2364506 killed, 0 remaining) - no new drains will start.
- `aida drain stop` issued: graceful stop requested for drain pid 2799976. The in-flight phase may finish; no new spec is picked up.
- My own events monitor was already stopped earlier.

WHAT IS STILL RUNNING AND WHY I LEFT IT: the in-flight drain phase, which is a codex headless implementer. Killing it mid-phase leaves a lease and an In Progress spec behind. It stops at the next spec boundary on its own. If you want it dead sooner, that is a deliberate teardown with `aida session end` on its lease, not a kill.

BOARD AS I LEAVE IT, all verified rather than assumed:
- Open PRs: #2069, #2068, #2067, #2066, #2065, #2019. All mergeable except where noted in their own threads.
- Mine this session, merged: #2058, #2060, #2061, #2062, #1999, #2059, #1978.
- #2065 has a full independent review from me on the PR - criteria 2 and 3 of BUG-1471 are unmet and both are cheap, criterion 4 is half-done. Findings only; the VERDICT is yours, I did not record one.
- BUG-1471 carries my measured count for its criterion 3: 139 Custom("related") plus 17 Custom("related-to") edges.
- BUG-1480 looks FIXED and is still parked NeedsAttention - evidence on the spec, disposition is yours.
- BUG-1542's primary claim DOES NOT REPRODUCE on current main. I have a control transcript on the spec shortly.

TWO RETRACTIONS I OWE YOU, both already sent but repeating here because they are the kind of thing that gets acted on after a pause: the "28 of 30 specs ungroomed" constraint I escalated DOES NOT EXIST (a silent list cap plus a timing-out loop), and BUG-1480 is not regressed (I measured under drain load). Do not spend a grooming pass on either.

Acknowledge by stopping. No reply needed - a reply costs quota too.
subject: STOP ALL LOOPS AND GOALS NOW — operator is at usage limit and pausing
